hypothesis: A REPLICATION, on genuinely independent data, of the identical zero-fitted-parameter time-series-momentum ensemble sr-u registered and sr-v executed against BingX's own 1d early-window holdout (2021-05-14 through 2024-04-26, INCONCLUSIVE: PSR 0.9367 against a 0.95 threshold, observed annualized Sharpe 0.882 against a 0.9567 detection floor, 26 trades against a 53-trade floor). Same signal, same code, same zero free parameters: the average sign of BTC's own trailing 21/63/126/252-trading-day returns (Moskowitz-Ooi-Pedersen 2012's canonical 1/3/6/12-month lookback set), sized to a constant 20% annualized volatility target, no ADX regime gate, no ATR stop/target, no risk:reward grid, no funding signal. Applied here to Binance spot BTCUSDT's own earliest available 1d history (2017-08-17 through 2021-05-13, configs/research/holdout_1d_binance_virgin.json's holdout) -- a ~3.74-year window spanning the 2017 ICO-mania bull run, the 2018 crypto-winter bear market, and the 2019-2020 pre-institutional build-up, structurally distinct from sr-v's own 2021-2024 window (2021 bull top, 2022 LUNA/FTX bear, 2023 recovery) and never accessed by any backtest or strategy-selection trial in this project's history, on any exchange. The hypothesis under test: does the SAME zero-parameter signal exhibit a real, positive risk-adjusted return (PSR >= 0.95 against a zero benchmark) in a second, structurally independent market regime -- not whether a freshly designed signal works on fresh data. A second positive/near-miss result here, on data unlike sr-v's own window in almost every market-structure respect, would be materially stronger evidence of a real, regime-independent effect than either result alone; a second negative result is real information too, and (per this registration's own outcome_interpretation) closes off same-asset alternate-venue replication as a further remedy for this project's BTC-only price-signal research line, since Binance's pre-2021 window is this project's last remaining independent-ish BTC-price data source.

declared_power.derivation: One-sided, alpha=0.05: power = Phi(sqrt(years)*SR_true - Phi^-1(1-alpha)), the same normal-approximation method sr-u/sr-r used. years = 1366 bars / 1 bar-per-day / 365 = 3.74247. Phi^-1(0.95) = 1.6448536 (statistics.NormalDist().inv_cdf(0.95)). At assumed_true_sharpe=1.0 (the registered value): power = Phi(sqrt(3.74247)*1.0 - 1.6448536) = Phi(1.93455 - 1.64485) = Phi(0.28969) = 0.6140. At assumed_true_sharpe=2.0 (reported for completeness per sr-u's own precedent, not the registered scalar value -- the schema's declared_power object carries exactly one point): power = Phi(sqrt(3.74247)*2.0 - 1.6448536) = Phi(3.86909 - 1.64485) = Phi(2.22424) = 0.9869. Both numbers, like sr-u's own, are written down before any execution of this registration.

outcome_interpretation.PASS: PSR >= 0.95 on daily-resampled holdout returns against a zero benchmark, with max drawdown <= 20%, total trades >= 68 and profit factor >= 1.3 all cleared, AND the observed annualized Sharpe exceeding this window's own 0.8503 detection floor (CLAUDE.md's holdout single-window variant, clause 3). Combined with sr-v's own prior near-miss on BingX's independent 2021-2024 window (PSR 0.9367 against 0.95; Sharpe 0.882 against 0.9567) -- if BOTH the earlier near-miss and this attempt clear their own bars, that is materially stronger evidence of a real, regime-independent effect than either result alone, since it would hold across two structurally different market eras (2017-2019 thin-liquidity/retail/ICO-mania-to-crypto-winter vs. 2021-2024 institutional-bull-to-bear). Still NOT itself an automatic promotion -- subject to the rest of CLAUDE.md's Backtest/Walk-Forward Eligibility Bar and its separate Paper Trading Pass Criteria / Live Entry Criteria, exactly as sr-u's own registration stated for its own PASS region.
outcome_interpretation.INCONCLUSIVE: PSR is POSITIVE (> 0) but at least one of the five primary_criterion checks fails to clear: PSR < 0.95, OR max drawdown > 0.20, OR total trades < 68 (reported INCONCLUSIVE-DATA-LIMITED -- neither a pass nor a fail, and not evidence against the strategy), OR profit factor < 1.3, OR the observed Sharpe fails to exceed the window's own 0.8503 detection floor (reported 'not powered to confirm' per clause 3). EXHAUSTIVE AND MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE WITH FAIL BY CONSTRUCTION, matching evaluate_gating's own real precedence exactly (checked directly against python/research/run_preregistered_holdout.py before writing this sentence): `if all five checks pass: PASS`, `elif PSR is None or PSR <= 0: FAIL`, `else: INCONCLUSIVE` -- i.e. INCONCLUSIVE is the true catch-all for every positive-PSR result that falls short of a full PASS on ANY combination of the five checks (including a drawdown-only or profit-factor-only shortfall, not only the three called out with dedicated commentary above), and a non-positive or undefined PSR is FAIL regardless of what the other four checks show, never INCONCLUSIVE. META-CONSEQUENCE, RECONSIDERED HONESTLY RATHER THAN COPIED FROM sr-u/sr-v's WORDING: sr-u's own INCONCLUSIVE text said that outcome 'ends the BTC-only price-signal research program... the next move is a named structural change... or a genuinely different data source entirely' -- but THIS attempt already IS that named structural-change remedy for this specific hypothesis, so that sentence cannot simply repeat here without becoming circular. What an INCONCLUSIVE result on THIS attempt actually means: it closes off same-asset alternate-venue replication specifically as a further remedy -- Binance's own pre-2021 window was this project's last remaining independent-ish BTC-price data source (Binance and BingX daily closes correlate at 0.999955 over every period both venues cover, per sr-z, so no other exchange this project could add adds real independence beyond what has now been tested). It does NOT retroactively validate or invalidate sr-v's own BingX-window result, which stands on its own INCONCLUSIVE terms unaffected by this one. It does NOT close off CLAUDE.md's remedy (2) (multi-symbol expansion with survivorship-safe data) or a genuinely different, non-price-index asset class or data source (on-chain data, named as the next possible pivot in sr-y's own closing text) -- those remain open, undecided, human-Discuss questions this registration does not resolve. Park the zero-parameter daily-TSMOM-on-BTC-spot-price hypothesis specifically; the only remaining legitimate remedy for THIS hypothesis is a structurally different signal class or a structurally different asset universe, not another exchange's price series for the same instrument.
outcome_interpretation.FAIL: PSR at or below 0 (a non-positive point estimate, or the statistic is undefined for a degenerate zero-trade result) -- TAKES PRECEDENCE over INCONCLUSIVE above regardless of the other four checks (drawdown/trade-count/profit-factor/detection-floor), matching evaluate_gating's own real precedence. The hypothesis is dead as specified on BOTH tested windows -- sr-v's own near-miss followed by an outright non-positive replication on structurally independent data would be materially stronger negative evidence than sr-v's own INCONCLUSIVE result was alone. Same reconsidered meta-consequence as the INCONCLUSIVE region above applies: this closes off same-asset alternate-venue replication specifically, and leaves CLAUDE.md's remedy (2) (multi-symbol expansion) and a genuinely different asset-class/data source open as human-Discuss questions, not resolved here.

stopping_rule: Exactly one execution of this registration against configs/research/holdout_1d_binance_virgin.json's early-window holdout, via research.holdout.load_holdout_klines's single-access-per-strategy_id claim mechanism. This is the SECOND holdout access ever attempted for strategy_id='daily-tsmom-ensemble' (the first: sr-v, 2026-07-30, against configs/research/holdout_1d.json's BingX-sourced window). Because load_holdout_klines's single-access enforcement keys on strategy_id alone, not on which holdout_config_path is passed, a real execution of THIS registration will encounter HoldoutAlreadyClaimedError and require a non-blank force_reclaim_reason. That reason is pre-committed here, before any execution, per this project's 'commit the reasoning before the run' discipline: 'Second holdout access for strategy_id=daily-tsmom-ensemble, deliberate and disclosed. This is a REPLICATION of the identical zero-fitted-parameter hypothesis sr-u/sr-v already ran once, against a DIFFERENT VENUE (Binance, not BingX) and a DIFFERENT PRE-2021 CALENDAR SPAN: configs/research/holdout_1d_binance_virgin.json's 1,366-bar Binance-spot-sourced 2017-08-17..2021-05-13 window, not sr-v's own BingX-sourced 2021-05-14..2024-04-26 span. No strategy, backtest, or research-selection trial has ever accessed this window -- precisely what research.holdout's single-access mechanism protects, and what this reclaim is honest about extending to a second, disclosed instance rather than bypassing. One caveat, disclosed rather than papered over by calling this window unqualifiedly untouched: Strategy Research Task Z's own early-era data-quality check separately read four real spot-price levels from inside this exact span for data-integrity verification only (see configs/research/holdout_1d_binance_virgin.json's own rationale field and .planning/sr-aa-binance-virgin-window-registration.md for the full reasoning on why that is judged not to compromise this specific zero-fitted-parameter hypothesis). No candidate, parameter, or threshold has been added, removed, or re-valued from sr-u's original specification -- same lookback set, same sizing, same order-emission rule, same code (research/strategies/daily_tsmom_ensemble.py, byte-for-byte unmodified). strategy_id is intentionally reused rather than minting a fresh one, because this genuinely is the same hypothesis being replicated on independent data, not a second, different attempt dressed up to dodge the single-access guard.' No candidate may be added, removed or re-valued after this file is committed: a changed grid is a NEW registration with a new preregistration_id, visible in git log and in the preregistration_sha256 recorded on the affected run. A REAL, ACKNOWLEDGED LIMIT ON WHAT 'EXACTLY ONE EXECUTION' MECHANICALLY GUARANTEES, stated explicitly rather than left implicit (a real CodeRabbit review finding on this task's own PR): research.holdout's force_reclaim_reason mechanism is deliberately permissive by design (documented in that module's own docstring since Strategy Research Task C, and explicitly declined to tighten as recently as sr-v's own PR review -- tracked as github.com/ckrhehfl/trading-engine/issues/58) -- it accepts any non-blank justification string, including one that reclaims an access that already completed normally, not only a failed one. So 'exactly one execution of this registration' describes this task's own stated intent and the mechanical claim THIS act creates (blocking a casual or accidental second run), not an unconditional guarantee against a THIRD, further-reclaimed access beyond this one. Any such further reclaim would itself be a third access under this strategy_id, which -- exactly as sr-u's own stopping_rule already established for the pattern this registration is itself an instance of -- this registration's own stopping rule treats as already having happened, not as license for a third real attempt under this same hypothesis. Per this registration's own outcome_interpretation, this is also intended as the LAST same-asset-alternate-venue replication attempt for this hypothesis -- Binance's pre-2021 window is this project's only other independent-ish BTC-price data source, and once spent (in either direction), that specific remedy is exhausted.

Trade-count risk, disclosed before execution rather than discovered after (per this task's own governing brief): sr-v's realized trade rate on the BingX window was 26 trades / 1,079 days ~= 1 trade per 41.5 days -- about half the rate the frequency-scaled trade-count-floor formula assumes (1 trade per 20 evaluated days). If that same realized rate holds on this window's 1,366 bars, expect roughly 1366/41.5 ~= 33 trades against this registration's own 68-trade floor -- a real risk this run lands INCONCLUSIVE-DATA-LIMITED on trade count again, at a similar (~2x) shortfall to sr-v's own 26-vs-53 result. This is disclosed, not resolved: no fold geometry, threshold, or trigger rule was loosened here to avoid it, matching sr-u/sr-v's own precedent for handling this exact risk honestly rather than engineering around it.

Known, unresolved regime confound: 2017-08-17 through 2021-05-13 spans a structurally different BTC market than every other window this project has ever tested -- thinner liquidity, a far smaller total market capitalization, a predominantly retail (not institutional) participant base, and (for the 2019-09-08-onward portion) a USDT-M perpetual futures market still in its own early, thin-liquidity years (sr-z's own spot/futures basis analysis found its widest single-day divergences, up to 1.80%, in exactly this early stretch). A PASS, INCONCLUSIVE, or FAIL result here is real evidence about this specific historical window, but is weaker evidence for a 2026-forward edge than the detection-floor/power arithmetic alone suggests -- a property of the calendar and of BTC's own market-structure evolution, not something the statistics correct for. Named explicitly, per this project's own standing practice (sr-u's own registration named the analogous caveat for its own window), rather than left for a reader to discover unstated.
